from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# In obs_0012: pose x=-0.750, y=1.433, heading 270.

arr12 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0012.png"))
blue_m12 = (arr12[:, :, 2] > 150) & (arr12[:, :, 0] < 50) & (arr12[:, :, 1] < 100)
y12, x12 = np.where(blue_m12)
print("obs_0012 jug bottom_y:", y12.max())
D12_ground = 256 * 1.55 / (y12.max() - 255.5)
print(f"obs_0012 D from ground: {D12_ground:.3f}")
'
